about: Quest events missing keys stopped the game: an event without type at load, a quest without quest_text at load, a quest without reward when it fired. Now: no type = mod error, event left out; no quest_text = mod error, the quest shows its id; no reward = a quest without a reward. A condition without a key its type needs (gold_gte without value) stopped the game when checked, and an unknown condition type (state_equal) was silent: both are mod errors now and never match.

steps.why: left out at load: firing it is only a log line
a quest without reward can be claimed
